run_generator_test: run the GeneratorTest unittest suite to verify protobuf Python code generator output
test_nested_message_descriptor: test that nested message descriptors match field message types in protobuf generated code
test_enum_values: test module-level and nested enum values in protobuf generated Python code
test_extreme_default_values: test protobuf messages with infinity and NaN default values for float and double fields
test_extension_range: test protobuf extension ranges and verify extension scope and containing type behavior
